name: coxph.control
title: Ancillary arguments for controlling coxph fits

origin.description: Collect the iteration and singularity tolerances for a Cox fit.
origin.usage: coxph.control(eps=1e-9, toler.chol=.Machine$double.eps^0.75, iter.max=20, toler.inf=sqrt(eps), outer.max=10, timefix=TRUE, survcheckallow='gap')
origin.details: Collect the iteration and singularity tolerances for a Cox fit.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(survival))
value <- (function() {
  ctl <- coxph.control()
  c(sprintf("%.17g", ctl$eps), sprintf("%.17g", ctl$toler.chol),
    sprintf("%.17g", ctl$iter.max), sprintf("%.17g", ctl$toler.inf),
    sprintf("%.17g", ctl$outer.max), sprintf("%d", as.integer(ctl$timefix)),
    ctl$survcheckallow)
})()
cat(paste(value, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Collect the iteration and singularity tolerances for a Cox fit.
translation.usage: coxph_control(eps=1e-9, toler_chol=None, iter_max=20, toler_inf=None, outer_max=10, timefix=True, survcheckallow='gap')
translation.details: Collect the iteration and singularity tolerances for a Cox fit.
translation.example:
from survival import coxph_control

def one():
    ctl = coxph_control()
    return [
        f"{ctl['eps']:.17g}",
        f"{ctl['toler.chol']:.17g}",
        f"{ctl['iter.max']:.17g}",
        f"{ctl['toler.inf']:.17g}",
        f"{ctl['outer.max']:.17g}",
        "1" if ctl["timefix"] else "0",
        ctl["survcheckallow"],
    ]

print("\n".join(one()))
